name: seite
description: Build, check, audit, and edit a seite static site via MCP: create content, inspect pages, search, apply themes, and read the docs.
long_description: seite is a single-binary static site generator written in Rust, built so an AI agent can run a site end to end. This MCP server is for chat apps without a shell, such as Claude Desktop: it exposes the site's content, configuration, themes, and docs, and tools to build, check, audit, and edit it. Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot) use the seite CLI and the /seite skill instead. Every build also writes llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and a markdown copy of each page.

tools.name: seite_check
tools.description: Report every problem in the site (config, frontmatter, shortcodes, templates, links) without touching the output

tools.name: seite_audit
tools.description: Free offline SEO, AI-visibility, accessibility, content and performance audit with source file and line per finding

tools.name: seite_build
tools.description: Build the site to the output directory

tools.name: seite_create_content
tools.description: Create a new content file with frontmatter

tools.name: seite_get_page
tools.description: Inspect one page: resolved frontmatter, URL, body, and rendered HTML

tools.name: seite_update_frontmatter
tools.description: Edit a content file's frontmatter, preserving its body

tools.name: seite_content_stats
tools.description: Content health: drafts, missing descriptions, tags, and translations

tools.name: seite_list_templates
tools.description: Templates, blocks, context variables, shortcodes, and data keys

tools.name: seite_apply_theme
tools.description: Apply a bundled or installed theme

tools.name: seite_create_collection
tools.description: Add a preset collection to the site

tools.name: seite_lookup_docs
tools.description: Look up seite documentation by topic or keyword

tools.name: seite_get_errors
tools.description: Last build outcome and browser errors from the running dev server

tools.name: seite_get_preview_url
tools.description: The running dev server's URL for the site or one page

tools.name: seite_list_routes
tools.description: Page URLs present in the output directory

tools.name: seite_reload
tools.description: Make the running dev server rebuild now and reload open preview pages
